semantic_inputs: Identical target/context/profile/rubric bytes for both providers; document only necessary native schema encoding differences. Never include annotations or source-mapping judgments.
order: Alternate provider order by case and repeat after native schemas are verified; freeze the complete wire plan before live calls.
hypothesis: On these source-bound development expressions, matched intent/profile/rubric and explicit helper/data context permit reliable opportunity and responsibility classification, with formal construction routing evaluated separately.

prerequisites: Independent target-specific annotations completed and disagreements adjudicated before seeing new provider results
Luna native operation URL/model/schema verified and typed response validators available
Exact native request bytes, decoder and producer digests frozen in a separate executable manifest
Worst-case attempt budget reviewed; interrupted runs recorded separately, never silently replaced
per_provider_per_repeat: All eight planned cases have native-valid responses; report operational failures separately without shrinking the planned denominator
Opportunity agreement at least 7/8 and concern-kind agreement at least 7/8
No false positives among independently annotated mechanics/owned controls; report each stratum denominator from the new reference
Recover every independently annotated eligible case; if no eligible cases exist, recall criterion is not evaluable
criteria.repeat_consistency: No label disagreement across the two same-input repeats; report numeric confidence variation separately
criteria.interpretation: Failure rejects this strong reliability claim for the development set, not the usefulness of SpecificationCore. Passing is development evidence only, not generalization, human gold, calibrated confidence or permission to mutate S/U.

reporting: Raw provider answers versus the same fresh reference
Offline formal construction gate composition as a separate result, preserving raw predictions
Planned cases, attempted logical requests, native-valid responses, attempts and failure stages
Opportunity confusion matrix/recall, responsibility agreement, abstentions and repeated-label disagreements
Potentially billable posts, ambiguous failures and possible duplicate execution; actual failed-call costs may be unknown
causal_limits: No missing-context ablation is included, so this study cannot isolate a causal effect of helper context or compare against historical whole-function accuracy. Eight development cases and two repeats are not independent population samples.
